fields.v: Partly (0.5): university authors, not vendors of Claude Code, Codex or the skills studied; but the pre-tool hook guard, evaluated in its own experiment (670 runs, RQ3), is the authors' own
fields.quote: We are the first to locate the point at which a conflict is decided and to show that a pre-tool hook at that point keeps the core functions of the installed skill.
fields.where: §1 Introduction (contributions), p. 4; §3.9 Measures and Analysis, p. 12; §4.4 RQ3, p. 15-16
fields.why: The Q12 rule counts an author who created an evaluated approach as its vendor (Partly when only some approaches), and the guard is a stated contribution evaluated with its own experiment and significance tests.
fields.doubt: O guard (hook antes da primeira leitura) é dos próprios autores e é avaliado numa experiência própria (670 execuções, RQ3) e listado como contribuição. Pela regra do Q12, isso pode dar Parcial (0,5) em vez de Sim. Decide se o guard conta como abordagem avaliada ou só como mitigação secundária.

fields.v: Yes (1): Threats to Validity section discusses internal validity (nondeterministic single runs, first read observed rather than assigned) and external validity (one platform with a Codex check, constructed cross-project pairs); LLM-judge validity handled in §3.10; conservative prevalence stated in §4.1
fields.quote: Internal validity. Runs are nondeterministic, and each combination of model, configuration, and pair runs once.
fields.why: A dedicated threats section covering internal and external validity is present, which other records with similar sections scored Yes, so Partly may be inconsistent.
fields.doubt: Há uma secção própria de ameaças à validade (interna e externa, pág. 17-18), e a validade do juiz LLM é tratada na secção 3.10. Noutros estudos com secções igualmente curtas deste lote deste Sim. Decide se o Q10 fica Parcial ou Sim, por coerência.
